data.title: Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Receives Liberian Ambassador to Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Elkhereiji received Ambassador of the Republic of Liberia to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Amara Sackor in Riyadh today.
    During the meeting, the two officials reviewed relations between the two countries and discussed issues of mutual interest.
    
    -- SPA
18:39 Local Time 15:39 GMT
